Default settings part creation fails with truncated XML

#### Description

When creating a default settings part, the XML content gets truncated causing the document structure to be incomplete. This results in an incorrect number of elements being parsed.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.parts.settings import SettingsPart
from docx.opc.package import OpcPackage

package = OpcPackage()
settings_part = SettingsPart.default(package)
print(f"Number of elements: {len(settings_part.element)}")
# Expected: 6 elements
# Actual: fewer elements due to truncated XML
```

The issue occurs when the default settings XML template is being read but only a portion of the file content is loaded, leading to malformed XML structure.
